features.title: Project harness and runnable service foundation
features.user_visible_behavior: The API and Streamlit shell can be set up, verified, started, inspected, and stopped through one PowerShell entry point.
features.verification: Run init.ps1 Setup, Verify, Start, Status, and Stop; confirm both health endpoints respond and source files match their supplied content.
evidence: init.ps1 -Action Setup completed successfully with the locked uv environment.
init.ps1 -Action Verify passed Ruff and pytest (1 test).
init.ps1 -Action Start made the API and Streamlit health endpoints return HTTP 200.
The three files in data/source are byte-for-byte identical to the supplied originals.
features.notes: Foundation only; no scheduling feature behavior is included.

features.title: Role-aware lesson management
features.user_visible_behavior: Owners can inspect the center schedule, receptionists can manage lessons safely, and tutors can see only their own current lessons.
features.verification: Exercise owner, receptionist, and tutor API access; create, update, and soft-delete a lesson; verify stale and unsafe writes are rejected; verify every mutation records history.
evidence: Phase 1 seed preview maps all CSV fields and rejects invalid input before database creation.
Phase 1 tests preserve 34 raw rows and create 33 lessons with 34 participants.
Phase 2 service and API tests cover role visibility, CRUD, revision history, stale edits, validation, privacy, and transaction rollback.
The complete verification suite passes 44 tests, including role-specific Streamlit navigation and API-client behavior.
A clean-start rehearsal imported 34 raw rows into 33 lessons, started both services, moved L034 to a valid back-to-back slot, recorded its revision, and showed the change only in tutor T1's schedule.
Rendered desktop and narrow-width reviews showed responsive navigation, complete lesson data, readable forms, and no browser console errors.
features.notes: Assessment MVP complete. Production authentication, push/read acknowledgement, messaging, billing, and two-way spreadsheet synchronization remain deferred.
